protocol: All comparisons use the same whole-date train/calibration/test indices. Original estimator uses its original centered scaler and intercept with C=1, fitted on the earlier training window, without random splitting. Feature-only comparison fits both feature sets with the new symmetric training and calibration protocol. No feature or hyperparameter changes were made in response to these test scores.
interpretation: Small improvement versus old features under matched symmetric training; no established overall superiority. Original estimator had better probability loss/Brier on this period. No bookmaker-odds or profitability benchmark exists. This is a fixed historical comparison, not automatically refreshed on retraining. Exact new-model scores are in evaluation.json for the corresponding run.
